nodes.name: power_3v3
nodes.description: AMS1117-3.3 LDO steps VIN_5V down to VCC_3V3 for digital supply. This module provides regulated 3.3V power to MCU and DAC. Input and output need bypass capacitors. GND pin connects to system common ground.

nodes.name: mcu
nodes.description: ATmega328P AVR MCU controlling MCP4725 DAC over I2C. I2C bus uses PC4 (SDA) and PC5 (SCL). Internal pull-ups enabled or external pull-ups placed in this module. VCC and AVCC powered from VCC_3V3; AVCC needs LC filter for analog noise rejection. AREF can use internal or external reference. BOOT0 not present; standard fuse configuration for Flash boot. Crystal pins PB6/PB7 for external 16MHz resonator if needed.

nodes.name: dac_control
nodes.description: MCP4725 12-bit I2C DAC providing bias/control voltage to audio preamplifier. I2C slave with address set by A0 pin (tie to GND or VCC for address selection). VOUT drives non-inverting input network of NE5532 channel 1. I2C pull-ups owned by MCU module. Output may need RC filtering for noise reduction before amplifier input.

nodes.name: VOUT
nodes.description: DAC analog output, rail-to-rail (0 to VDD).

nodes.name: VDD
nodes.description: Supply voltage (2.7-5.5V), also serves as DAC reference.

nodes.name: SDA
nodes.description: I2C data, open-drain. Requires external pull-up on bus.

nodes.name: SCL
nodes.description: I2C clock, open-drain. Requires external pull-up on bus.

nodes.name: A0
nodes.description: I2C address bit. VSS=0x60, VDD=0x61. Must not float.

nodes.name: audio_preamp
nodes.description: NE5532 dual low-noise op-amp configured as single-channel non-inverting audio preamplifier. Channel 1: non-inverting input receives DAC bias/control voltage through input network (resistive divider/RC network added downstream), IN1_N receives feedback network for gain setting, OUT1 provides amplified audio output. Channel 2 unused: IN2_P and IN2_N tied to safe bias state (mid-rail or GND), OUT2 left unconnected (DNC). VCC_P powered from VIN_5V, VCC_N to GND. Separate analog ground star point recommended near amplifier for noise control.
